StatDef.label: biomass extraction speed
StatDef.description: Extraction skill speed is 100% at Cooking 10 or below. Cooking alone improves speed above 10, up to 200% by default at Cooking 20. General work speed, sight and manipulation apply separately.

StatDef.label: biomass extraction yield
StatDef.description: Raw recovery is capped at recipe yield. Cooking below 10 causes random wastage, rolled once at completion, with at least one biomass recovered. Cooking above 10 does not increase yield.
